tours.name: A Very Long Job Title on an Employee

name_i18n.en_US: A Very Long Job Title on an Employee

tours.description: Learn how a very long text in the job title field behaves on the employee form, without saving anything.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how a very long text in the job title field behaves on the employee form, without saving anything.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: Employees are created in the Employees app.

description_i18n.en_US: Employees are created in the Employees app.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to start an employee.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to start an employee.

steps.description: The form opens empty. This practice is never saved.

description_i18n.en_US: The form opens empty. This practice is never saved.

steps.title: Type a long job title
steps.content: Type a very long job title, about 100 characters, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type a very long job title, about 100 characters, then press Tab.

steps.description: A job title may be long, for example for a combined role. Odoo accepts it, but lists and badges cut long text, so keep titles short in real data.

description_i18n.en_US: A job title may be long, for example for a combined role. Odoo accepts it, but lists and badges cut long text, so keep titles short in real data.

steps.title: Check the field
steps.content: Look at the field. Click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Look at the field. Click it to continue.

steps.description: The field keeps the whole text, even if it does not all fit on the screen.

description_i18n.en_US: The field keeps the whole text, even if it does not all fit on the screen.

steps.title: Discard
steps.content: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

steps.description: Nothing was stored, so this practice leaves no trace. Fill in the required fields and save if you want to keep a real record.

description_i18n.en_US: Nothing was stored, so this practice leaves no trace. Fill in the required fields and save if you want to keep a real record.
